classification: availability limitation of the unsupervised prototype deployment

attempts.detail: TypeError: fetch failed in part D; node fetch reports every socket error identically and the harness recorded no cause
attempts.fix: api() unwraps and reports the cause chain

attempts.detail: socket to the API observed CLOSED with the fetch promise still pending; stalled over 20 minutes at zero CPU in part G
attempts.fix: api() carries an explicit 120 s ceiling above the API's own 90 s decision ceiling

attempts.outcome: AI listener halted permanently after one model-inference timeout
attempts.detail: listener exited by design on a >60 s inference and nothing restarted it
attempts.fix: external supervisor added as deployment configuration only

listenerHalt.trigger: a single model inference exceeding the 60 s LLM_POLICY_TIMEOUT_MS
mechanism: run() catches, logs, and deliberately re-throws so the checkpoint is not advanced past an unanswered request
backend/package.json runs the listener as a bare node process, so nothing restarts it
listenerHalt.designIntent: avoid advancing the checkpoint past a committed but unanswered request so a restart retries it
listenerHalt.gap: the design assumes a supervisor that the prototype deployment did not provide

safetyOutcome.statement: SEAL failed safely under the observed model-timeout condition: no unauthorized access was granted and the unanswered request remained committed and retryable.

availabilityOutcome.statement: In the unsupervised prototype deployment the timeout terminated the AI decision listener, requiring service restart before authorization processing could resume.

stabilityDegradation.note: every failure is HTTP 202 'the policy model has not answered yet'; payload mismatches were zero throughout, so the ledger was healthy and nothing was answering
